tools.name: lookup_project
tools.description: Return the external identifiers PulseGate holds for one project, and for each one how it arrived and whether anyone has checked that it belongs. Makes no claim about whether the software is alive, maintained, or working. Look up by slug, or by an identifier you already have.

tools.name: list_identifier_platforms
tools.description: List every platform PulseGate records identifiers on, with how many identifiers it holds for each. Use it to learn the vocabulary the platform argument of lookup_project accepts.
